English: Prayer Stand
A simple, movable stand for communal prayers, marking the beginnings of Israelite worship in the open steppe.
Stone Marker
A more permanent stone marker, serving as a gathering point for prayers and community events.
Wooden Pavilion
A simple wooden structure offering shelter for worship, and a focal point for the Israelite community.
Teaching Room
A modest enclosure for study and instruction, fostering religious unity among nomadic Israelites.
Torah Chamber
A dedicated chamber for Torah scrolls and learned discussion, cementing cultural identity and tradition.
Sanctuary Hall
A large, well-built hall serving as a sanctuary for worship and community gatherings, strengthening spiritual unity.
Ritual Pavilion
An ornate pavilion for sacred rituals and major gatherings, reinforcing the Israelite clans religious identity.
Community Synagogue
A sturdy, permanent synagogue that serves as the heart of the Israelite nomad community, anchoring faith and unity.
Scholars Hall
A renowned center for religious study and debate, drawing Israelite scholars from across the steppe.
Grand Israelite Synagogue
A majestic, awe-inspiring synagogue, the spiritual heart of the Israelite nomads—uniting clans and strengthening the faith for generations.
